idea-plugin.name: WebSocket Client Plus
idea-plugin.description:
A simple WebSocket client for IntelliJ platform IDEs.
This plugin adds WebSocket panel to your tool window.

In the panel, you can connect to a WebSocket API and can submit/receive.

Original Plugin: WebSocket Client

适配了 IDEA 2026，新增了定时心跳请求、格式化 JSON 字符串等实用功能。
